Source contracts: setup-manual.sh

setup-manual.sh

Shell · Tier B

Install the optional manual rendering dependencies in the root environment.

Usage

Prepare the standalone manual without starting its HTTP service.

Inputs

PYTHON_BIN selects a Python 3.11+ interpreter; AOR_MANUAL_HOST/PORT affect the printed endpoint.

Side effects

Creates or recreates incompatible .venv, upgrades pip tooling, installs the editable manual extra and marks manual launch scripts executable.

Cleanup

Exits after installation; no server child remains. Recreated environments are not restored on failure.
